description: run namespace: every field of the projection is PRESENT. A field the run cannot supply is null; the two failed-step fields are seeded placeholders and are empty strings, because they are read on the success path as the whole value of a message body.
notes: started_at is compared as the ISO-8601 round-trip form of the value the vector supplies, so the case stays deterministic without a redaction rule. CORRECTED 2026-08-28: this vector expected null for failed_step_id / failed_step_error, which is what another implementation emitted and NOT what the oracle emits. The oracle seeds them as empty strings on purpose - a notify node reached by an `always` edge reads them on the SUCCESS path, and as a JSON null the message body becomes null and a handler that requires one refuses a step that used to work. The rule is that the oracle defines; this vector had been written from the wrong implementation.
